body.name: published threshold scales and valid projector lower bound
body.construction: After the isometric reduction to fixed support coordinates, Acartürk et al.'s Section 5 equation (22) is \(\eta^{\ast}(P)=\min\{\lambda_i(R(M)):M\subseteq[n],\ i\in[n],\ \lambda_i(R(M))>0\}\). Their printed equation (23) is \(\gamma^{\ast}(G)=\min_{i\in[n]}\|H_{i,:}\|_2\|G_{:,i}\|_2\). Separately, the valid projector geometry is quantified by \(\rho_i(G)=(\|H_{i,:}\|_2\|G_{:,i}\|_2)^{-1}\) and \(\rho^{\ast}(G)=\min_{i\in[n]}\rho_i(G)\); \(\rho^{\ast}(G)\) is not the printed \(\gamma^{\ast}(G)\).
